item.title: Dems vow to force weekly Iran war votes after GOP blocks latest move to curb Trump
item.summary: Senate Republicans blocked another war powers resolution, this time from Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., as Democrats vow to force at least one vote per week.

item.title: FBI’s ‘Operation Box Cutter’ indicts Chinese pharma firms, terror-linked cartel assets in fentanyl takedown
item.summary: FBI Director Kash Patel revealed a historic crackdown on Chinese pharmaceutical companies allegedly supplying the Gulf cartel with fentanyl precursors.

item.title: Biden-era CIA report tied support of 'motherhood,' 'homemaking' to White extremist ideology
item.summary: The CIA warned that extremist groups prioritize motherhood and homemaking for recruitment, according to retracted Biden-era assessments flagged for political bias.

item.title: TSA warns shutdown is forcing some workers to draw blood to pay for gas
item.summary: Deputy TSA Administrator Stahl said agents are selling blood plasma and sleeping in cars as the 38-day shutdown left 50,000 workers without pay.

item.title: Chicago man accused of synagogue shooting threat, targeting Israeli official released on bond
item.summary: A Chicago man accused of threatening to shoot up a synagogue and making antisemitic posts on X was freed on $100,000 bond over prosecutors' objection.

item.title: California university cancels gubernatorial debate after backlash for all White candidates
item.summary: USC canceled a planned California gubernatorial debate for Tuesday after candidate Xavier Becerra accused the university of excluding candidates of color.

item.title: Kim Kardashian faces parenting police over praising son's 'dangerous' e-bike trick
item.summary: Kim Kardashian shared a photo of son Saint, 11, popping a wheelie on an electric bike, sparking fan criticism and safety concerns about the risky stunt.

item.title: If someone gets into your email, they own every account you have. These 3 moves lock them out for good
item.summary: Criminals don't need your passwords to drain your accounts — they just need your email. Here's how account takeover fraud works and how to stop it.

item.title: Nancy Guthrie’s neighbor noticed ‘atypical’ pet behavior night of disappearance, earlier date: report
item.summary: A neighbor says his dogs woke him on Jan. 11 and Feb. 1, dates under scrutiny in the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, mother of Savannah Guthrie.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Cameras capture truckers unable to read road signs, answer basic questions during Florida crackdown
item.summary: Troopers say up to half of truckers at some Florida weigh stations fail English proficiency tests as the Trump administration ramps up Department of Transportation enforcement.
